thread:
Ravi (CSM): Tinley week0 sync: quick list before cutover planning — still open: firewall 443/9443, IAM role for redwood-runner, CMK key policy + alias, and audit log retention. Can we get one-line status updates?

Hannah (Network): Waiting on their infra for NAT egress IPs (they sent subnets 10.200.0.0/16). We can't apply firewall until we have NAT pool. Propose minimal ingress rules: 443 to proxy, 9443 for telemetry from their collector only.

Marco (SRE): KMS: They created CMK with alias `alias/tinley-main` and key-id `abcd-1111-2222`. Our automation looks for `alias/redwood-customer-*`. Short-term we can deploy referencing key-id, but rotation & auto-attach won't work.

Jin (Security): Audit retention: Tinley currently keeps CloudTrail logs 45d. Compliance baseline for priv customers is 365d. This is a renewal risk. Ravi please push on extending retention or propose compensating controls.

Ravi (CSM): I've asked Tinley for a justification and costs. They say S3 cost is the concern. I'll send a delta estimate (45d vs 365d) and offer our archival policy (move to Glacier after 30d) as a lower-cost option.

Hannah (Network): Sample firewall snippet we recommended to Tinley — dropping into ticket:
```
- allow tcp 443 from 10.200.0.0/16 to 10.7.3.22/32 (redwood-proxy)
- allow tcp 9443 from 10.200.10.0/24 to 10.7.3.23/32 (collector)
- allow tcp 22 from 198.51.100.0/24 to 10.7.3.30/32 (bastion)
```
Also noted: they route via transit-gw; ask them to enable path MTU discovery and set `tcp-mss` if problems.

Marco (SRE): For KMS policy, we need them to add our runner role ARN to the key policy. Example snippet I pasted in runbook this morning. If they can't, we will attach via key-id and add a manual step for rotation.

Jin (Security): On IAM: Their infra team wants to reuse an existing role `deploy/engine` instead of creating `redwood-runner`. We require either creating `redwood-runner` or adding our account as trusted principal with external-id. Quick trust policy example sent in thread.

Ravi (CSM): Actionable asks I'll send in the 1pm checklist to Tinley:
- Provide NAT egress IP list (needed by Hannah)
- Update CMK key policy to include `arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-runner` OR confirm we'll use key-id fallback (Marco)
- Update CloudTrail retention or agree to Glacier archival + sign-off (Jin)
- Provide Splunk collector fqdn + owner email so we can issue cert (certs-bot)

certs-bot: Please provide fqdn and contact email. Cert will be issued as PEM signed by redwood-internal, TTL 90d.

Marco (SRE): Runbook note added: `if alias != alias/redwood-customer-*, use key-id and create ticket CS-4319 to follow up on alias rename`. runbook-bot: acknowledged and attached snippet.

runbook-bot: Runbook updated: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4319. Reminder: include key-id fallback steps and an alert to SRE on rotation events.

Hannah (Network): Once NAT IPs arrive I'll stitch the firewall policy and schedule a short maintenance window (15m) to apply. If they need transit-gw we need ASN + route table ID.

Jin (Security): One more: ask them if they plan to enable SSE-KMS on the S3 bucket for audit logs; if yes ensure CMK policy permits `s3:PutObject` for `arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-runner`.

Ravi (CSM): Noted. I'll push these in the checklist email and ask for signoffs by EOD. Mid-week follow-up scheduled. :thumbsup:

certs-bot: Reminder: CS-4319 waiting on fqdn/contact.

Ravi (CSM): Thanks team. Will post their responses and update ticket.
